# RxLabs®

> Software laboratory. Running code, public evidence and figures that can be measured again.

Site: https://rxlabs.org/en
Documentation: https://rxlabs.org/en/docs
Contact: knightsys@proton.me
Complete text: https://rxlabs.org/en/llms-full.txt

## Projects

- **echOS 3.0** — edge robotics unikernel with a sensor→intent pipeline, safety gate and PX4 bridge. [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echos/que-es)
- **PRISMA** — EEG analysis for research with an event-driven Rust engine. [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/prisma/resumen)
- **echoAI** — two-clock situated agent with a 16-byte WSP, CAM, T, Q and gate. ECHO-1 and ECHO-2 are closed; ECHO-3 has 8 of 15 software phases closed. [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/que-es)

## ECHO-3 now

SIM-3, FLIGHT-1S, SENSOR-1S, GROUND-1, DYNAMIC-1, PATTERN-1R, FUSION-1 and COMPOSE-1 are closed. The agent runs declarative A/B/C worlds, receives sourced evidence, retains sensor disagreement and composes access to a blocked goal. COMPOSE-1 keeps 6,144 functional B/C missions and 32 PX4 SITL flights.

- [Article: ECHO-3 has passed halfway](https://rxlabs.org/en/articulos/echo3-a-mitad)
- [Roadmap](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/ruta)
- [Results](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/resultados)
- [Architecture](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/piezas)

Results describe defined test banks. Do not attribute general autonomy, physical hardware or an LLM in echoAI’s fast loop.
